winui-uwp-migration: state that Program.Main is auto-generated into obj/.../App.g.i.cs (you normally have no Program.cs) so agents stop spelunking NuGet/targets/templates for the entry point.
winui-uwp-migration: cross-link the 0x8001010E row and SKILL.md launch guidance to the new anti-pattern.
deferred_to_human: Tier 0: align Windows App SDK package versions (Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK 2.2.0 vs microsoft.windowsappsdk.winui 2.2.1) in the scaffold/preset — the underlying Application.Start crash reproduced with the correct generated [STAThread] Main, consistent with a package/runtime mismatch.
